# PTPN — Personal Training in Enfield ("Be fit")

PTPN is one-to-one personal training by Pedro, in Bush Hill Park, Enfield, London, UK.
Coaching since 2016, 10,000+ sessions delivered. Level 3 Personal Trainer, Sports Conditioning Coach.

- Offer: personalised programmes measured every session (weight, body fat, loads, consistency), nutrition targets and meal plans, all tracked in the included PTPN app (no extra cost).
- First step: free consultation, no obligation. Enquiries: https://www.ptpn.co.uk/#contact or info@ptpn.co.uk
- Packages (per session, paid in person, no contracts): Express 12x30min £32.50/session; Ignition 4x60min £54; Momentum 8x60min £48; Signature 12x60min £40; Duo small-group £100/month.
- Specialisms: weight loss, strength, hypertrophy, mobility, return to training after injury or long breaks, boxing, calisthenics, older adults and beginners.
- Member app (existing clients): https://nevespedropt-prog.github.io/PTPN/
- Site: https://www.ptpn.co.uk | Blog: https://www.ptpn.co.uk/blog/
